comparisons.peer_topic: Property, Plant, and Equipment Depreciation and Capitalized Interest Expenses
comparisons.peer_summary: Depreciation expense for property, plant, and equipment was $7.70 billion in 2024, $7.67 billion in 2023, and $7.03 billion in 2022. Additionally, interest capitalized as part of the cost of these assets amounted to $225 million in 2024, $208 million in 2023, and $77 million in 2022.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclose significant depreciation charges related to manufacturing and process technology assets for fiscal year 2024. While Intel specifically details $2.3 billion in non-cash impairments and $992 million in accelerated depreciation due to excess capacity in its Intel 7 node, Micron reports a total depreciation expense for property, plant, and equipment of $7.70 billion. Both disclosures relate to the capital intensity of their manufacturing operations, but Intel highlights specific impairment events driving non-cash charges, whereas Micron presents the aggregate depreciation amount without mentioning impairments in this specific text.

sentences.text: In total, we recorded non-cash impairments and accelerated depreciation charges of $2.3 billion and $992 million, respectively, in 2024, substantially all of which were recognized in cost of sales within our Intel Foundry operating segment.
Depreciation expense was $7.70 billion, $7.67 billion, and $7.03 billion for 2024, 2023, and 2022, respectively.
